# MCP tools

Every tool pyeye registers, with its parameters, types and defaults, read from the live registration.

## Core tools

`configure_packages`, `expand`, `inspect`, `outline`, `resolve`, `resolve_at`, `trace`

### `configure_packages`

| Parameter | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `packages` | `list[str] \| None` | `null` |
| `namespaces` | `dict[str, list[str]] \| None` | `null` |
| `standalone_dirs` | `list[str] \| None` | `null` |
| `save` | `bool` | `true` |
| `project_path` | `str` | `"."` |

### `expand`

| Parameter | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|

| `project_path` | `str` | `"."` |
| `max_stubs` | `int \| None` | `200` |
